labels.title: The TX sidecar destination is unnamed and lands in the RU sidecar namespace, with no freshness refusal on the TX path.
The authored-assertion join rule across `exchanges[]` and `actions[]` is unspecified, so `authoredAssertionsAllPassed` can be computed from the wrong assertion set.
Where a rejected or absent TX handoff surfaces is contradictory; as written it can fail the existing TX positive test.
Comparison semantics for the pre-hook capture versus the parsed handoff bytes are unspecified.
`copySourceBytes`/`parseBoundedJson` cannot be reused for report wrappers without naming a `kind`.
`maxWorkers 2` is stated as if it were an existing default.
`serializeProfileEvidence` is never stated to enforce the unbound closed schema, so the plan3 correction has no enforcement point.
The TX→RU-helper import is not declared in the footprint.

rootDisposition: PENDING; clean terminal is not finding approval or source release
